district.summary: NJSIAA is not running District Championship Tournaments in 2026-27 (also not run in 2025-26), so there is no current district assignment. The last published district list puts Governor Livingston in District 5.
district.lastKnownDistrictAsOf: NJIFA page says assignments are 'from the NJSIAA [as of 25 October 2021]'; not re-verified against the 2024-25 alignment (last season districts were held).
district.noDistrictsQuote: There will be no District Championship Tournaments.

teamTournamentSection.note: What replaces districts for team qualification: teams are split into a North and a South section; the top 16 in each by power points qualify. In 2025-26 both GL teams were placed in the SOUTH section. The 2026-27 section lists/classifications are not yet published (the NJSIAA classification PDFs currently say 'COMING SOON').

tournaments.name: Cetrulo Tournament (NJIFA boys state team/squad championships)
tournaments.projectedDateReasoning: Strong projection, one step short of explicit. The NJSIAA 2026-27 tournament regulations (posted 2026-11-09) say independent fencers 'will qualify at Drew University during the Cetrulo/Santelli Tournament' and list the 'Independent Boys Fencer Qualifier - Drew University - January 16, 2027' (a Saturday). The regs never print the words 'Cetrulo: January 16', so this is not marked confirmed. Last season the same pattern held (girls qualifier Sat Jan 17 2026 = Santelli day; boys qualifier Sun Jan 18 2026 = Cetrulo day). Note the boys/girls days swap versus last season: in 2026-27 boys are Saturday, girls Sunday.
tournaments.venueNote: Venue for 2026-27 is given as Drew University in the NJSIAA regs; the Simon Forum building name and street address come from the NJIFA Cetrulo & Santelli page (ZIP added from general knowledge).
tournaments.description: The biggest boys high school fencing event of the year - nearly every NJ school brings its epee, foil and sabre squads to one giant all-day tournament, with trophies for the best squad in each weapon and the best overall team.

tournaments.name: Santelli Tournament (NJIFA girls state team/squad championships)
tournaments.projectedDateReasoning: Strong projection, one step short of explicit. NJSIAA 2026-27 regs list the 'Independent Girls Fencer Qualifier - Drew University - January 17, 2027' (a Sunday) and state that the independent qualifier is held 'at Drew University during the Cetrulo/Santelli Tournament'. The regs do not literally say 'Santelli: January 17'. Last season the Santelli was Saturday Jan 17 2026 and matched the girls qualifier date in that season's regs.
tournaments.venueNote: Venue for 2026-27 is given as Drew University in the NJSIAA regs; building name and street address from the NJIFA Cetrulo & Santelli page (ZIP added from general knowledge).
tournaments.description: The girls' counterpart to the Cetrulo - a huge one-day tournament where almost every NJ girls team's epee, foil and sabre squads fence each other for weapon-squad and overall team titles.

tournaments.name: NJSIAA Individual State Championships
tournaments.venueNote: Venue named in the 2026-27 regs; street address is from general knowledge, not from the cited source - verify before publishing. Check-in times per weapon are still 'TBD' in the regs.

tournaments.name: NJSIAA / NJIFA State Squad Championships
tournaments.confirmationNote: No standalone squad state championship appears in the NJSIAA regs for 2026-27, 2025-26, 2024-25 or 2023-24. GL is a Union County school; I could not verify whether GL has entered before. Registration closes 2027-01-02. Ask the coach before listing as a GL event.

gaps: Cetrulo and Santelli 2026-27 dates are NOT explicitly published by NJIFA anywhere I could reach. Jan 16 (boys/Cetrulo) and Jan 17 (girls/Santelli), 2027 at Drew University are inferred from the NJSIAA regs' independent-qualifier dates, which the regs say take place 'during the Cetrulo/Santelli Tournament'. Treat as high-confidence projections and confirm with the coach or NJIFA. Start times and the building (Simon Forum has been the venue) are also unconfirmed for 2026-27.

The NJIFA site (sites.google.com/site/njifa2) is stale: home page shows 2023-24, the 'Important Dates' page says 2022-23, and its public Google Calendar stops in 2020. njifa.com was not separately checked for newer content beyond that Google Site.

District assignment: districts no longer exist as a competition (none in 2025-26 or 2026-27). 'District 5' for GL is from an NJIFA list dated 25 October 2021; I did not find the 2024-25 district list to re-verify it.
2026-27 North/South section assignment and classifications are not published yet (NJSIAA classification PDFs say 'COMING SOON'). GL was in the South section in 2025-26.

The NJSIAA 2026-27 regs PDF contains date typos (girls Round 2 'February 11, 2076', girls Round 3 'February 17, 20267', boys Sectional Finals 'February 23. 2026'). I used the clean dates shown on the njsiaa.org fencing page; a corrected PDF may be reposted.
Individual State Championships check-in times per weapon are 'TBD' in the regs.
Team tournament rounds are at the higher seed, so venues are unknowable until seeding on Feb 8, 2027, and GL's participation depends on qualifying (top 16 in section at the Feb 6 cutoff).
State Squad Championships: no standalone event exists in the NJSIAA regs for any of the last four seasons; I found no source that explicitly announces its discontinuation.

Holiday-break invitationals: I found no NJ high school fencing invitational listed for the Dec 2026 break. Morris Knolls Frosh/Soph used to be 'last week of December' per NJIFA but is now in January (Jan 10, 2027). An old Patch item mentions a GL-hosted 'holiday quad meet' years ago; nothing current found.

County/conference tournament: I found no Union County Conference fencing tournament or championship. County/league events that exist (Passaic County Championships, Bergen-Passaic Frosh-Soph, Skyland Conference Frosh-Soph, Lakeland Girls' Invitational, NJ Prep School Championships) are for other counties/leagues or private schools, so GL would not enter them; they are deliberately left out of the tournaments list.

Whether GL actually enters the three freshman/sophomore invitationals (Morris Knolls Jan 10, Columbia Cougar Clash Feb 20, Montclair - date unknown) is unverified; entrant lists show club names rather than schools. Morris Knolls has an eligibility restriction GL may not meet; Montclair is invitation-only. Confirm with the coach.
Montclair Freshman/Sophomore Invitational: no 2026-27 listing yet; only the 2026 girls event (Feb 8, 2026) was found, and it is unclear whether there is a separate boys event.

GL results at Cetrulo/Santelli (2024, 2025, 2026), at the 2024 and 2025 District 5 tournaments, and any GL individual-state qualifiers/placings were NOT found: nj.com article pages (www.nj.com) block automated fetching, fencingtimelive requires login, and no TAPinto/Patch coverage for those seasons surfaced. Only NJSIAA team-tournament bracket results are recorded in glPastResults.

Venue street addresses for Hunterdon Central (84 Route 31, Flemington) and the Drew/Madison ZIP code come from general knowledge rather than the cited 2026-27 sources; Morris Hills' address comes from an old NJIFA calendar entry. Verify before publishing.

Bonus, outside the brief: nj.com already lists a partial 2026-27 GL dual-meet schedule (10 meets, Dec 9, 2026 vs Morris Knolls through Feb 5, 2027 vs Randolph) at https://highschoolsports.nj.com/school/berkeley-hts-gov-livingston/boysfencing/season/2026-2027 and .../girlsfencing/season/2026-2027. Nothing on it clashes with the Jan 16-17 Cetrulo/Santelli weekend. The page lists dual meets only, no tournaments.
